'''Kema Forge''' was a [[Thief/Legends|thief]] who made [[Gender/Legends|his]] living by running small-time cons on various worlds across the galaxy. Eventually he ran afoul of a local crime boss who wiped Forge out financially. When Forge tried to strike back, he was captured and sold into slavery.<ref name="Game" />

He was consigned to a slaver named [[Deezoth Caraz]] who was to transport him to a [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]]. He and another slave named [[Ara (Deezoth Caraz)|Ara]] were watched over by Caraz's bodyguard, [[Vok]]. While on [[Ord Mynock/Legends|Ord Mynock]], Forge managed to steal a small knife from the bar they were in and started to plan his escape.<ref name="Game" />
